verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents nothing about notification settings: no per-channel notification controls, no keyword alerts, and no schedules or do-not-disturb. Subscribing to a channel affects where conversations appear, and keyword search is a separate feature, so neither counts as notification tuning. The axis applies to a team chat product, so the lack of evidence is 'none'.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can tune notifications per channel, keyword, and schedule so only what matters interrupts me
